title: The host's own name resolves to the podman VM, not the host, on macOS
foundBy: session agent, while fixing the lender's guest address (SBX CI, run 32792053483)
details:
R52 pins the host's own names to the literal 169.254.1.2 in the seed's host_hosts. That address is the host only on a Linux box running podman itself with pasta. An older podman maps the host at slirp4netns' own address, and under a podman machine the literal is the VM rather than the Mac. So `ssh <your-hostname>` or `curl <your-hostname>:PORT` from a sandbox reaches the wrong machine on macOS and on a pre-5.0 podman, while R109 claims macOS parity.

This is the same defect R52a already fixed for the lender, which now points a sandbox at host.containers.internal and lets podman supply the address. The host's own names were left on the literal.

It is invisible to CI: TestCLIHostByNameLive and TestCLIHostByNameFirecrackerLive are integration-tier and run on Linux only. The smoke tier reached this class of bug only when TestCLILendKeyLive first opened a connection to the host rather than resolving a name.

The fix that needs no host-side platform detection: have the guest init resolve host.containers.internal at boot and pin the host's names to whatever that gives, falling back to the seeded literal when the engine published no such name (the microVM guest, where the seed pins it already).
